threshold_rationale: Paper-machinery experiment calibrated to the observed six-hour live graph on 2026-09-07: 5 distinct buyers was approximately the 75th percentile across 1,473 launches. All launches that pass the evidence gates are evaluated; there is no second random down-sampling gate. A positive 2-75% short return, curve state, executable liquidity, impact, and round-trip cost remain mandatory. These defaults are intended to generate enough simulated outcomes to evaluate the machinery and are not evidence of predictive edge.
